    vineyard: '<svg class="wp-svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><g transform="translate(1.18 2.21) scale(1.0256)" stroke-width="1.463"><path d="M12.75 13.75L6.75 16.75L1.30279 14.0264C0.964002 13.857 0.75 13.5107 0.75 13.132V2.36803C0.75 1.62465 1.53231 1.14116 2.19721 1.47361L6.75 3.75M6.75 16.75V3.75M6.75 3.75L12.75 0.75L18.1972 3.47361C18.536 3.643 18.75 3.98926 18.75 4.36803V15.132C18.75 15.8753 17.9677 16.3588 17.3028 16.0264L12.75 13.75M12.75 13.75V0.75" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></g></svg>',
    varietal: '<svg class="wp-svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><g transform="translate(4.26 1.18) scale(1.0256)" stroke-width="1.463"><path d="M8.75 8.75C8.75 9.85457 7.85457 10.75 6.75 10.75C5.64543 10.75 4.75 9.85457 4.75 8.75M8.75 8.75C8.75 7.64543 7.85457 6.75 6.75 6.75M8.75 8.75C8.75 9.85457 9.64543 10.75 10.75 10.75C11.8546 10.75 12.75 9.85457 12.75 8.75C12.75 7.64543 11.8546 6.75 10.75 6.75C9.64543 6.75 8.75 7.64543 8.75 8.75ZM4.75 8.75C4.75 7.64543 5.64543 6.75 6.75 6.75M4.75 8.75C4.75 9.85457 3.85457 10.75 2.75 10.75C1.64543 10.75 0.75 9.85457 0.75 8.75C0.75 7.64543 1.64543 6.75 2.75 6.75C3.85457 6.75 4.75 7.64543 4.75 8.75ZM6.75 6.75C6.75 4.75 7.75 3.25 9.75 2.75M6.75 12.75C6.75 13.8546 7.64543 14.75 8.75 14.75C9.85457 14.75 10.75 13.8546 10.75 12.75C10.75 11.6454 9.85457 10.75 8.75 10.75C7.64543 10.75 6.75 11.6454 6.75 12.75ZM6.75 12.75C6.75 13.8546 5.85457 14.75 4.75 14.75C3.64543 14.75 2.75 13.8546 2.75 12.75C2.75 11.6454 3.64543 10.75 4.75 10.75C5.85457 10.75 6.75 11.6454 6.75 12.75ZM8.75 16.75C8.75 17.8546 7.85457 18.75 6.75 18.75C5.64543 18.75 4.75 17.8546 4.75 16.75C4.75 15.6454 5.64543 14.75 6.75 14.75C7.85457 14.75 8.75 15.6454 8.75 16.75ZM6.77472 3.75449C6.77466 0.254454 3.77469 0.777725 3.77469 0.777725C3.77469 0.777725 3.27471 4.2545 6.77472 3.75449Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></g></svg>',
    color: '<svg class="wp-svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><g transform="translate(-2.57 -2.57) scale(1.1429)" stroke-width="1.312"><path d="M12 20C13.5913 20 15.1174 19.3789 16.2426 18.2735C17.3679 17.168 18 15.6686 18 14.1053C18 12.4211 17.5 11 15.5 9C13.5 7 12.4286 6.10526 12 4C11.5714 6.10526 10.5 7 8.5 9C6.5 11 6 12.4211 6 14.1053C6 15.6686 6.63214 17.168 7.75736 18.2735C8.88258 19.3789 10.4087 20 12 20Z" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></g></svg>',
    type: '<svg class="wp-svg" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none"><g transform="translate(1.18 1.18) scale(1.0256)" stroke-width="1.463"><path d="M5.25 11.75C7.73528 11.75 9.75 9.41092 9.75 6.52552C9.75 5.42727 9.75 2.75 9.75 2.75C9.75 2.75 2.28933 2.75 0.750003 2.75C0.750003 2.75 0.75 3.64011 0.75 6.52552C0.75 9.41092 2.76472 11.75 5.25 11.75ZM5.25 11.75L5.25 18.75M9 18.75H1.5M15.75 11.289C17.4069 11.289 18.75 9.72708 18.75 7.80042C18.75 7.06709 18.75 0.750001 18.75 0.750001C18.75 0.750001 13.7762 0.75 12.75 0.75C12.75 0.75 12.75 5.87376 12.75 7.80042C12.75 9.72708 14.0931 11.289 15.75 11.289ZM15.75 11.289L15.75 18.75M18.25 18.75H13.25" stroke="currentColor" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/></g></svg>'
  };
  var WINE_COLORS = {RED:'Red', WHITE:'White', ROSE:'Rosé', ORANGE:'Orange'};
  var WINE_STYLES = {SWEET:'Sweet', FORTIFIED:'Fortified', SPARKLING:'Sparkling'};
  var NOT_WINE = {SAKE:'Sake', CIDER:'Cider', BEER:'Beer', SPIRIT:'Spirit'};
  function colorAndStyle(type){
    if(!type) return {};
    if(NOT_WINE[type]) return {style: NOT_WINE[type]};
    var parts = String(type).split('-');
    if(parts.length === 2) return {color: WINE_COLORS[parts[1]] || parts[1], style: WINE_STYLES[parts[0]] || parts[0]};
    return {color: WINE_COLORS[type] || type, style: 'Dry'};
  }
  var PROFILE_ROWS = [
    ['vintage', 'Vintage'], ['producer', 'Producer'], ['appellation', 'Appellation'],
    ['origin', 'Origin'], ['classification', 'Classification'], ['designation', 'Designation'],
    ['vineyard', 'Vineyard'], ['varietal', 'Varietal'], ['color', 'Color'], ['type', 'Type']
  ];
  function pausaOrigin(w){
    var r = regionOf(w); if(!r || !REGION_NAME[r]) return '';
    var country = String(w.region || '').split(',').pop().trim();
    return REGION_NAME[r] + (country ? ', ' + country : '');
  }
  function wineProfileHtml(w){
    // Pausa's feed names the type field `wineType`; Camper's names it `type`.
    var split = colorAndStyle(w.type || w.wineType);
    var values = {
      // null and 0 are both non-vintage, exactly as yearTag reads them on the row above - older
      // payloads send null where newer ones send 0, and a wine cannot simply have no vintage row.
      vintage: (w.year == null || w.year === 0) ? 'NV' : String(w.year),
      // `origin` rather than `region`: region leads with the APPELLATION, which the row above
      // already prints, so the profile said Montefalco twice.
      // Pausa's feed has no `origin` yet, so it falls back to the Italian region resolved for the map
      // (e.g. "Piemonte, Italy"). When the backend starts sending `origin`, that wins automatically.
      producer: w.producer, appellation: w.appellation, origin: w.origin || pausaOrigin(w),
      classification: w.classification, designation: w.designation,
      vineyard: w.vineyard, varietal: w.varietal, color: split.color, type: split.style
    };
    var rows = PROFILE_ROWS.filter(function(r){ return values[r[0]]; }).map(function(r){
      return '<div class="wp-row"><span class="wp-ic">'+(WINE_ICONS[r[0]] || '')+'</span>' +
             '<span class="wp-k">'+esc(r[1])+'</span>' +
             '<span class="wp-v">'+esc(values[r[0]])+'</span></div>';
    }).join('');
    if(!rows) return '';
    return '<div class="wp-acc"><div class="wp-panel" id="wpPanel">' +
      '<div class="modal-section-label">Wine Profile</div><div class="wine-profile">'+rows+'</div></div>' +
      '<button type="button" class="wp-toggle" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="wpPanel">' +
      '<span class="wp-word">More</span><span class="wp-sign" aria-hidden="true">+</span></button></div>';
  }
  // Tapping the fork&knife icon → the food pairings for this wine.
  function openWinePairingsModal(idx){
    var w = WINES[idx]; if(!w) return;
    var groups = pairsWithGroups(w);
    var html = modalHead('Food Pairings', shownName(w), metaLines(w)[0] || '') + '<div class="modal-body">' +
      (groups || '<div class="pw-empty">No pairings listed for this wine.</div>') + '</div>';
    openModal(html);
  }
  /* A dish's wine list is deliberately longer than what we show here: it is also what gives each
     WINE a decent spread of dishes on its own card. This view is the kitchen's shortlist — the few
     bottles they would actually name at the table — so it shows only the wines flagged `featured`.
     Older data has no flags, so fall back to the first few rather than rendering the whole list. */
  function featuredPairs(d){
    var all = d.wines || [];
    var featured = all.filter(function(pw){ return pw.featured; });
    return featured.length ? featured : all.slice(0, DISH_FEATURED_MAX);
  }
  function openDishModal(ci, di){
    var d = SRC.pairings.courses[ci].dishes[di]; if(!d) return;
    var pairs = featuredPairs(d).map(pairRowHtml).join('');
    var html = '<div class="modal-head"><div class="modal-eyebrow">Pairing</div>' +
      '<div class="modal-title">'+esc(d.name)+'</div>' + closeBtn() + '</div><div class="modal-body">' +
      (d.desc ? '<div class="modal-dish-desc">'+esc(d.desc)+'</div>' : '') +
      '<div class="modal-pairs">'+pairs+'</div></div>';
    openModal(html);
  }

  /* ---------- cover + contents pages ----------
     Both are optional: a restaurant without CONFIG.cover / CONFIG.contents opens straight on the
     menu exactly as before. Pages are addressable by hash so the browser Back button and QR deep
     links work:  (none) cover  ·  #contents  ·  #menu  ·  #menu/<filter-slug>  */
  var ICONS = {
    info:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 11v6"/><path d="M12 7.5h.01"/></svg>',
    search:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="6.5"/><path d="m20 20-4.2-4.2"/></svg>',
    list:'<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M8 6h12M8 12h12M8 18h12"/><path d="M4 6h.01M4 12h.01M4 18h.01"/></svg>'
  };
  ICONS.pair = HINT_SVG;
  function hasCover(){ return !!(CFG.cover && CFG.cover.enabled !== false); }
  function hasContents(){ return !!(CFG.contents && CFG.contents.enabled !== false); }
  function glassCount(){ return WINES.filter(function(w){ return w.glassPrice != null; }).length; }
  // {wines} {glass} {sections} in cover copy are filled from the live data, so counts never go stale.
  function fillTokens(t){
    return esc(t || '').replace(/\{wines\}/g, WINES.length).replace(/\{glass\}/g, glassCount())
      .replace(/\{sections\}/g, menuSections().length);
  }
  function renderCover(){
    var el = document.getElementById('coverView');
    if(!hasCover()){ el.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    var c = CFG.cover, img = c.imageUrl;
    var heroStyle = img ? ' style="background-image:url(\''+esc(img)+'\');background-position:'+esc(c.imagePosition||'center')+'"' : '';
    var logoSrc = c.logoUrl || CFG.logoUrl;
    var logo = logoSrc ? '<img class="cover-mark'+(c.invertLogo?' invert':'')+'" src="'+esc(logoSrc)+'" alt="">' : '';
    var howto = (c.features||[]).map(function(f){
      return '<li><span class="howto-icon" aria-hidden="true">'+(ICONS[f.icon]||ICONS.info)+'</span>' +
        '<div><div class="howto-title">'+fillTokens(f.title)+'</div><div class="howto-text">'+fillTokens(f.text)+'</div></div></li>';
    }).join('');
    el.innerHTML =
      '<div class="cover'+(img?' has-image':'')+'"'+heroStyle+'><div class="cover-panel">' +
        '<div class="cover-head">' + logo + '<h1 class="cover-title">'+esc(CFG.restaurantName)+'</h1>' +
          '<div class="cover-sub">'+esc(CFG.menuLabel||'')+'</div></div>' +
        (c.lede ? '<p class="cover-lede">'+fillTokens(c.lede)+'</p>' : '') +
        (howto ? '<ul class="cover-howto">'+howto+'</ul>' : '') +
        '<div class="cover-actions">' +
          '<button class="btn-primary" data-go="'+(hasContents()?'contents':'menu')+'">'+esc(c.cta || (hasContents()?'Open the contents':'View the list'))+'</button>' +
        '</div>' +
        (CFG.address ? '<div class="cover-address">'+CFG.address+(CFG.contact?'<br>'+CFG.contact:'')+'</div>' : '') +
      '</div></div>';
  }
  /* Groups come from CONFIG.contents.groups if set, else from the print runs (so the digital
     contents mirrors the printed booklet), else one group. Sections keep sectionOrder's order. */
  function contentsGroups(){
    var secs = menuSections(), used = {}, groups = [];
    var defs = (CFG.contents && CFG.contents.groups) ||
      ((CFG.print && CFG.print.runs) || []).map(function(r){ return {label:r.label, sections:r.sections||[]}; });
    defs.forEach(function(d){
      var items = secs.filter(function(sec){ return (d.sections||[]).indexOf(sec.label) > -1 && !used[sec.label]; });
      items.forEach(function(sec){ used[sec.label] = true; });
      if(items.length) groups.push({label:d.label, items:items});
    });
    var rest = secs.filter(function(sec){ return !used[sec.label]; });
    if(rest.length) groups.push({label: groups.length ? 'More' : (CFG.menuLabel || 'Menu'), items:rest});
    return groups;
  }
  function renderContents(){
    var el = document.getElementById('tocView');
    if(!hasContents()){ el.innerHTML = ''; return; }
    var t = CFG.contents, glass = glassCount(), glassPlaced = false;
    var row = function(cat, name, count, extra){
      return '<li><button class="toc-row'+(extra||'')+'" data-go="menu" data-cat="'+esc(cat)+'">' +
        '<span class="toc-name">'+esc(name)+'</span><span class="toc-leader" aria-hidden="true"></span>' +
        '<span class="toc-count">'+count+'</span></button></li>';
    };
    var groups = contentsGroups();
    var groupHtml = groups.map(function(g){
      var rows = '';
      if(glass && !glassPlaced && g.items.some(function(sec){ return sec.kind === 'wine'; })){
        rows += row('glass', 'By the Glass', glass, ' is-glass'); glassPlaced = true;
      }
      rows += g.items.map(function(sec){
        var subs = subsFor(sec);
        if(!subs) return row(slug(sec.label), sec.label, sec.items.length);
        return subs.map(function(sub){ return row(sub.cat, sub.label, sub.count); }).join('');
      }).join('');
      return '<section class="toc-group"><h2 class="toc-group-label">'+esc(g.label)+'</h2><ul class="toc-list">'+rows+'</ul></section>';
    });
    /* The region map sits after the group named by regionMap.after, else after the first group that
       holds wine. Groups before it and after it each flow in their own column block. */
    var split = groups.length, rmCfg = hasRegionMap() ? CFG.contents.regionMap : null;
    if(rmCfg){
      split = -1;
      groups.forEach(function(g, gi){ if(split < 0 && rmCfg.after && g.label === rmCfg.after) split = gi + 1; });
      if(split < 0) groups.forEach(function(g, gi){ if(split < 0 && g.items.some(function(sec){ return sec.kind === 'wine'; })) split = gi + 1; });
      if(split < 0) split = 0;
    }
    var block = function(list, cls){ return list.length ? '<div class="toc-groups'+(cls||'')+'">'+list.join('')+'</div>' : ''; };
    var groupsHtml = block(groupHtml.slice(0, split), split === 1 ? ' is-single' : '') +
      (rmCfg ? regionMapHtml() : '') + block(groupHtml.slice(split), groupHtml.length - split === 1 ? ' is-single' : '');
    el.innerHTML = '<div class="toc"><h1 class="toc-title">'+esc(t.title||'Contents')+'</h1>' +
      (t.intro ? '<p class="toc-intro">'+fillTokens(t.intro)+'</p>' : '') +
      groupsHtml +
      '<div class="toc-actions"><button class="btn-primary" data-go="menu" data-cat="all">See the full list</button>' +
      '<button class="btn-link" data-go="menu" data-cat="all" data-focus-search="1">Ask the virtual somm</button></div></div>';
  }
  /* CONFIG.contents.split lets one menu section show as several contents lines, divided by
     wineType, e.g. "Bianchi & Rosé" -> Bianchi (WHITE) and Rosé (ROSE). Each line filters the menu. */
  var SUBCATS = {};
  function subsFor(sec){
    var defs = CFG.contents && CFG.contents.split && CFG.contents.split[sec.label];
    if(!defs || sec.kind !== 'wine') return null;
    var out = defs.map(function(d){
      var types = (d.wineTypes || []).map(function(t){ return String(t).toUpperCase(); });
      var cat = slug(sec.label) + '~' + slug(d.label);
      var n = sec.items.filter(function(w){ return types.indexOf(String(w.wineType||'').toUpperCase()) > -1; }).length;
      SUBCATS[cat] = {group:slug(sec.label), types:types, label:d.label};
      return {cat:cat, label:d.label, count:n};
    }).filter(function(x){ return x.count > 0; });
    return out.length ? out : null;
  }
  /* CONFIG.sectionSplit divides one backend section into several menu sections by wineType, e.g.
     "Bianchi & Rosé" -> Bianchi (WHITE) + Rosato (ROSE). Applied on every load, so a backend rebuild
     that still sends the combined section is re-split automatically. A wine matching no rule goes to
     the first one. Old links to the combined section land on the first new one. */
  var SECTION_ALIAS = {};
  function splitSections(){
    var rules = CFG.sectionSplit || {};
    Object.keys(rules).forEach(function(orig){
      var parts = rules[orig] || []; if(!parts.length) return;
      SECTION_ALIAS[slug(orig)] = slug(parts[0].label);
      parts.forEach(function(p){
        SECTION_ALIAS[slug(orig) + '~' + slug(p.label)] = slug(p.label);
        (p.wineTypes || []).forEach(function(t){ SECTION_ALIAS[slug(orig) + '~' + slug(t)] = slug(p.label); });
      });
    });
    WINES.forEach(function(w){
      var parts = rules[w.section]; if(!parts || !parts.length) return;
      var t = String(w.wineType || '').toUpperCase();
      var hit = parts.filter(function(p){ return (p.wineTypes || []).map(function(x){ return String(x).toUpperCase(); }).indexOf(t) > -1; })[0];
      w.sourceSection = w.section;
      w.section = (hit || parts[0]).label;
    });
  }
  function validCat(cat){
    if(!cat) return CFG.defaultFilter || 'all';
    if(SECTION_ALIAS[cat]) cat = SECTION_ALIAS[cat];
    if(SUBCATS[cat]) return cat;
    if(isRegionCat(cat)) return regionCounts()[cat.slice(7)] ? cat : 'all';
    if(cat === 'all' || bucketFor(cat) || bucketOfSection(cat)) return cat;
    if(crossFilters().some(function(c){ return c.cat === cat; })) return cat;
    if(cat === 'pairings' && SRC.pairings && SRC.pairings.courses && SRC.pairings.courses.length) return cat;
    return CFG.defaultFilter || 'all';
  }
  var firstRoute = true;
  function showPage(page, cat){
    closeModal();
    document.body.classList.remove('page-cover','page-contents','page-menu');
    document.body.classList.add('page-' + page);
    var tt = document.getElementById('toTop'); if(tt) tt.hidden = true;
    // Landing straight on the menu keeps the masthead in view; arriving from a link pins the section.
    if(page === 'menu') openCat(validCat(cat), !firstRoute || !!cat);
    if(page === 'menu' && cat && SECTION_ALIAS[cat]) setHash('#menu/' + SECTION_ALIAS[cat], true);
    else window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'auto'});
  }
  function route(){
    setTimeout(function(){ firstRoute = false; }, 0);
    var parts = decodeURIComponent((location.hash || '').replace(/^#/, '')).split('/');
    if(parts[0] === 'contents' && hasContents()) return showPage('contents');
    if(parts[0] === 'menu') return showPage('menu', parts[1]);
    if(parts[0] === '' && hasCover()) return showPage('cover');
    showPage('menu');
  }
  function setHash(h, replace){
    var url = location.pathname + location.search + h;
    try { history[replace ? 'replaceState' : 'pushState'](null, '', url); } catch(e) {}
  }
  function go(page, cat){
    setHash(page === 'cover' ? '' : page === 'contents' ? '#contents' : '#menu' + (cat ? '/' + cat : ''));
    showPage(page, cat);
  }
  /* Close the book: back to a fresh state for the next table - no search text, no filter, no open
     pop-up, top of the page - then the cover. */
  function closeBook(){
    closeModal();
    var input = document.getElementById('searchInput'); input.value = ''; input.blur(); searchTerm = '';
    setActive(CFG.defaultFilter || 'all', false);
    ['filterRow1','filterRow2'].forEach(function(id){ var port = portOf(document.getElementById(id)); if(port) port.scrollLeft = 0; showScrollEdges(document.getElementById(id)); });
    if(hasCover()) go('cover'); else { go('menu'); window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'auto'}); }
  }
  function pageClick(e){
    var r = e.target.closest('[data-reset]'); if(r){ closeBook(); return; }
    var b = e.target.closest('[data-go]'); if(!b) return;
    go(b.getAttribute('data-go'), b.getAttribute('data-cat') || undefined);
    if(b.hasAttribute('data-focus-search')) setTimeout(function(){ document.getElementById('searchInput').focus(); }, 60);
  }

    'valle-daosta':['aosta valley',"valle d'aosta","vallee d'aoste"],
    lombardia:['bergamasca','franciacorta','lugana','riviera del garda classico','sforzato di valtellina','valtellina superiore',
      'valtellina','oltrepo pavese','valcalepio','lombardia','lombardy'],
    'trentino-alto-adige':['alto adige','alto adige sudtirol','sudtirol','trentino','trentino alto adige','trentodoc','teroldego rotaliano','vigneti delle dolomiti'],
    veneto:['amarone della valpolicella','valpolicella','valpolicella ripasso','bardolino','breganze','colli euganei','conegliano valdobbiadene prosecco',
      'prosecco superiore','soave','recioto di soave','custoza','veneto','delle venezie'],
    'friuli-venezia-giulia':['friuli colli orientali','colli orientali del friuli','collio','carso','friuli venezia giulia','friuli','venezia giulia','friuli isonzo'],
    'emilia-romagna':['reggiano','lambrusco di sorbara','lambrusco grasparossa di castelvetro','emilia','romagna','colli piacentini'],
    liguria:['cinque terre','riviera ligure di ponente','colli di luni','liguria'],
    toscana:['bolgheri','bolgheri superiore','brunello di montalcino','rosso di montalcino','chianti classico','chianti','carmignano','maremma toscana',
      'morellino di scansano','vino nobile di montepulciano','rosso di montepulciano','vernaccia di san gimignano','toscana','tuscany','costa toscana'],
    umbria:['montefalco','montefalco sagrantino','orvieto','torgiano','umbria'],
    marche:['verdicchio dei castelli di jesi','verdicchio di matelica','offida','rosso conero','conero','rosso piceno','marche'],
    lazio:['lazio','cesanese del piglio','frascati'],
    abruzzo:["montepulciano d'abruzzo","trebbiano d'abruzzo","cerasuolo d'abruzzo",'abruzzo'],
    molise:['molise','tintilia del molise'],
    campania:["costa d'amalfi",'fiano di avellino','greco di tufo','taurasi','roccamonfina','terre del volturno','irpinia','falerno del massico',
      'campi flegrei','ischia','vesuvio','sannio','campania'],
    puglia:['salento','primitivo di manduria','castel del monte','salice salentino','puglia','apulia'],
    basilicata:['aglianico del vulture','aglianico del vulture superiore','basilicata'],
    calabria:['ciro','calabria'],
    sicilia:['etna','etna bianco','etna rosso','etna rosato','terre siciliane','sicilia','sicily','cerasuolo di vittoria','marsala','pantelleria','faro','salina'],
    sardegna:['vermentino di gallura','cannonau di sardegna','carignano del sulcis','romangia','isola dei nuraghi','sardegna','sardinia']
  };
  var APP_TO_REGION = {};
  Object.keys(APPELLATION_REGION).forEach(function(k){ APPELLATION_REGION[k].forEach(function(a){ APP_TO_REGION[a] = k; }); });
  function plain(s){ return norm(s).normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').replace(/-/g,' '); }
  function regionOf(w){
    if(w._region !== undefined) return w._region;
    var r = null, ar = w.adminRegion && plain(w.adminRegion).replace(/ /g,'-');
    if(ar && REGION_NAME[ar]) r = ar;
    if(!r && w.adminRegion) r = APP_TO_REGION[plain(w.adminRegion)] || null;
    if(!r) r = APP_TO_REGION[plain(w.appellation)] || null;
    if(!r){ // longest alias that appears as a phrase in the appellation or region text
      var hay = ' ' + plain((w.appellation||'') + ' ' + (w.region||'')) + ' ', best = '';
      Object.keys(APP_TO_REGION).forEach(function(a){ if(a.length > best.length && hay.indexOf(' '+a+' ') > -1) best = a; });
      if(best) r = APP_TO_REGION[best];
    }
    return (w._region = r);
  }
  function mixHex(a, b, t){
    var pa = parseInt(a.replace('#',''),16), pb = parseInt(b.replace('#',''),16), out = '#';
    [16,8,0].forEach(function(sh){ var x = Math.round(((pa>>sh)&255) + (((pb>>sh)&255) - ((pa>>sh)&255)) * t); out += ('0'+x.toString(16)).slice(-2); });
    return out;
  }
  function regionCounts(){
    var c = {}; WINES.forEach(function(w){ var r = regionOf(w); if(r) c[r] = (c[r]||0) + 1; }); return c;
  }
  function hasRegionMap(){ return hasContents() && CFG.contents.regionMap && CFG.contents.regionMap.enabled !== false; }
  function regionMapHtml(){
    var counts = regionCounts(), max = 0, keys = Object.keys(counts);
    if(!keys.length) return '';
    keys.forEach(function(k){ max = Math.max(max, counts[k]); });
    var rm = CFG.contents.regionMap, shapes = '', badges = '', rows = '';
    // Shade from the light brand tint (fewest wines) to the brand primary (most wines).
    var C = CFG.colors || {}, lo = C.headerRule || C.divider || '#cccccc', hi = C.primary || '#1a1a1a';
    REGIONS.forEach(function(r){
      var k = r[0], d = ITALY_MAP.paths[k], n = counts[k]; if(!d) return;
      if(!n){ shapes += '<g class="rg rg-none"><path d="'+d+'"/></g>'; return; }
      var fill = mixHex(lo, hi, Math.sqrt(n / max)), label = r[1] + ', ' + n + ' wine' + (n===1?'':'s');
      shapes += '<g class="rg rg-has" data-go="menu" data-cat="region-'+k+'" data-rg="'+k+'" role="button" tabindex="0" aria-label="'+esc(label)+'">' +
        '<title>'+esc(label)+'</title><path d="'+d+'" style="fill:'+fill+'"/></g>';
      var p = ITALY_MAP.labels[k];
      badges += '<g class="rg-badge" data-go="menu" data-cat="region-'+k+'" data-rg="'+k+'" aria-hidden="true">' +
        '<circle cx="'+p[0]+'" cy="'+p[1]+'" r="11.5"/><text x="'+p[0]+'" y="'+p[1]+'">'+n+'</text></g>';
      rows += '<li><button class="toc-row" data-go="menu" data-cat="region-'+k+'" data-rg="'+k+'">' +
        '<span class="toc-name">'+esc(r[1])+'</span><span class="toc-count">'+n+'</span></button></li>';
    });
    return '<section class="toc-regions"><h2 class="toc-group-label">'+esc(rm.title||'By Region')+'</h2>' +
      (rm.intro ? '<p class="toc-intro" style="margin:10px auto 4px;">'+fillTokens(rm.intro)+'</p>' : '') +
      '<div class="region-wrap"><svg class="italy-map" viewBox="-14 -14 '+(ITALY_MAP.w+28)+' '+(ITALY_MAP.h+28)+'" role="group" aria-label="Map of Italy by wine region">' +
      shapes + badges + '</svg><div><ul class="region-list">'+rows+'</ul>' +
      '<p class="map-credit">Region boundaries: ISTAT, CC BY 4.0</p></div></div></section>';
  }
  // Hovering a region, its badge or its list row lights up all three together.
  function wireRegionHover(root){
    function set(k, on){ root.querySelectorAll('[data-rg="'+k+'"]').forEach(function(el){ el.classList.toggle('hot', on); }); }
    root.addEventListener('mouseover', function(e){ var t = e.target.closest('[data-rg]'); if(t) set(t.getAttribute('data-rg'), true); });
    root.addEventListener('mouseout', function(e){ var t = e.target.closest('[data-rg]'); if(t) set(t.getAttribute('data-rg'), false); });
    root.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
      if((e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') && e.target.matches('.rg-has')){ e.preventDefault(); e.target.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', {bubbles:true})); }
    });
  }

  /* ---------- wiring ---------- */
  function wire(){
    document.getElementById('searchInput').addEventListener('input', function(e){ searchTerm = e.target.value.toLowerCase().trim(); applyView(); });
    document.getElementById('filterTracks').addEventListener('click', function(e){ var chip = e.target.closest('.filter-chip'); if(!chip) return;
      var cat = chip.getAttribute('data-category');
      if(cat === 'contents'){ go('contents'); return; }
      setActive(cat); setHash('#menu/' + cat, true); });
    document.getElementById('sectionTracks').addEventListener('click', function(e){ var chip = e.target.closest('.filter-chip'); if(!chip) return;
      setSection(chip.getAttribute('data-category')); setHash('#menu/' + (currentSection || currentCategory), true); });
    ['filterRow1', 'filterRow2'].forEach(function(id){
      var row = document.getElementById(id);
      portOf(row).addEventListener('scroll', function(){ showScrollEdges(row); }, {passive:true});
    });
    window.addEventListener('resize', function(){ ['filterRow1','filterRow2'].forEach(function(id){ showScrollEdges(document.getElementById(id)); }); });
    document.getElementById('coverView').addEventListener('click', pageClick);
    document.getElementById('tocView').addEventListener('click', pageClick);
    var mast = document.getElementById('masthead');
    if(hasContents()){ mast.classList.add('to-contents'); mast.addEventListener('click', function(){ go('contents'); }); }
    window.addEventListener('popstate', route);
    document.getElementById('closeBook').addEventListener('click', closeBook);
    document.getElementById('closeBookContents').addEventListener('click', closeBook);
    var toTop = document.getElementById('toTop'), tick = false;
    function syncToTop(){ tick = false; toTop.hidden = window.scrollY < window.innerHeight * 1.2; }
    window.addEventListener('scroll', function(){ if(!tick){ tick = true; requestAnimationFrame(syncToTop); } }, {passive:true});
    toTop.addEventListener('click', function(){
      var smooth = !(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches);
      window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior: smooth ? 'smooth' : 'auto'});
    });
    wireRegionHover(document.getElementById('tocView'));
    document.getElementById('regionBanner').addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var b = e.target.closest('[data-rb]'); if(!b) return;
      if(b.getAttribute('data-rb') === 'map'){ go('contents'); var m = document.querySelector('.toc-regions'); if(m) m.scrollIntoView(); }
      else if(b.getAttribute('data-rb') === 'unsub'){ currentSub = null; updateBanner(); applyView(); setHash('#menu/' + (currentSection || currentCategory), true); }
      else { setActive('all'); setHash('#menu/all', true); }
    });
    document.getElementById('wineListContainer').addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var pb = e.target.closest('.pair-btn'); if(pb){ openWinePairingsModal(parseInt(pb.getAttribute('data-wine-pairs'),10)); return; }
      var ni = e.target.closest('.wine-name-txt.wn-clickable'); if(ni){ openWineInfoModal(parseInt(ni.getAttribute('data-wine-info'),10)); }
    });
    document.getElementById('pairingsView').addEventListener('click', function(e){ var d = e.target.closest('.dish'); if(d) openDishModal(parseInt(d.getAttribute('data-course'),10), parseInt(d.getAttribute('data-dish'),10)); });
    overlay.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      var t = e.target.closest('.wp-toggle'); if(t){ toggleWineProfile(t); return; }
      if(e.target===overlay || e.target.closest('.modal-close')) closeModal();
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if(e.key==='Escape') closeModal(); });
  }

  /* Portrait-only guard. Uses the SCREEN's orientation, not the viewport's: on Android the on-screen
     keyboard shrinks the viewport until it looks landscape, and the notice must not flash up while a
     guest types in the search box. Touch devices only, so a desktop in a wide window is never blocked. */
  function isTouchDevice(){
    return !!(window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(hover: none) and (pointer: coarse)').matches) ||
      (navigator.maxTouchPoints > 1 && /Macintosh/.test(navigator.userAgent)); // iPadOS reports as a Mac
  }
  // Landscape only when the device says so AND the visible window is wider than tall. The second
  // check stops a false alarm where the orientation API and the real window disagree.
  function screenIsLandscape(){
    var wide = window.innerWidth > window.innerHeight, dev;
    if(screen.orientation && screen.orientation.type) dev = screen.orientation.type.indexOf('landscape') === 0;
    else if(typeof window.orientation === 'number') dev = Math.abs(window.orientation) === 90;
    else dev = wide;
    return dev && wide;
  }
  function markTablet(){
    var shortSide = Math.min(screen.width || 0, screen.height || 0);
    document.documentElement.classList.toggle('is-tablet', isTouchDevice() && shortSide >= 600);
  }
  function checkOrientation(){
    var n = document.getElementById('rotateNotice'); if(!n) return;
    var block = isTouchDevice() && screenIsLandscape();
    n.hidden = !block;
    document.body.classList.toggle('is-landscape-device', block);
    if(block && document.activeElement && document.activeElement.blur) document.activeElement.blur();
  }
  function wireOrientation(){
    // Where the browser allows it (installed web app / full screen on Android) actually lock portrait.
    try { if(screen.orientation && screen.orientation.lock) screen.orientation.lock('portrait').catch(function(){}); } catch(e) {}
    if(screen.orientation && screen.orientation.addEventListener) screen.orientation.addEventListener('change', checkOrientation);
    window.addEventListener('orientationchange', function(){ setTimeout(checkOrientation, 50); });
    window.addEventListener('resize', checkOrientation);
    markTablet();
    checkOrientation();
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function(){
    wireOrientation();
    if(!CFG){ console.error('Menu data (CONFIG/WINES/SOURCE_CONTENT) not loaded.'); return; }
    WINES.forEach(function(w){ WINE_BY_NAME[norm(w.name)] = w; });
    if(SRC.pairings && SRC.pairings.courses)
      SRC.pairings.courses.forEach(function(co){ (co.dishes||[]).forEach(function(d){ (d.wines||[]).forEach(function(pw){ PAIR_NAMES[norm(pw.name)] = true; }); }); });
    splitSections();
    applyTheme(); loadClarity(); renderChrome(); buildFilters(); renderMenu(); renderPairings();
    overlay = document.getElementById('modalOverlay');
    renderCover(); renderContents();
    wire();
    route();
  });
})();
</script>
</body>
</html>
